dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro_html:
Cleveridge is an innovative smart-fridge system that intelligently automates everyday household tasks, bringing more clarity and comfort to your kitchen.
The project combines modern web technology, sensors, and artificial intelligence to fully digitize and manage the contents of your fridge.

At its core is a camera connected to a Raspberry Pi 5 that regularly captures images of the inside of the fridge. An integrated computer-vision AI analyzes these images and automatically identifies the items present. In addition, built-in sensors monitor temperature and humidity in real time to ensure optimal storage conditions. All captured information is displayed in a user-friendly web interface available on both smartphone and PC.
